description: Class representing a single header or footer section (left, center or right) of a page.

GetText.description: Returns the text of this header or footer section.

returns.description: The section text (may contain formatting codes such as &P, &D).

SetText.description: Sets the text of this header or footer section, preserving the other two sections.

params.description: The section text (may contain formatting codes such as &P, &D).
params.name: sText

returns.description: Returns true if the operation is successful.
